Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (PROJECT_LOG.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Android + Windows audio volume/EQ utility with Android Play/Direct and Windows desktop audio processing, with distinct DSP, endpoint and actual physical acoustic evidence.** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

Trace first-run permission/setup, device switching, EQ preset application, gain changes, updater channel, error/recovery and Windows native versus Android controls; use actual installed UX instead of assuming source-only pass. Report friction grounded in real screen/workflow evidence: first-time versus returning, desktop versus mobile, loading/empty/error/recovery states, accessibility, discoverability and time-to-goal. Preserve approved layouts and branding. Suggest the smallest coherent usable change and how it must be verified on the **actual platform**. Explicitly identify what should be simplified or removed; do not claim to have executed physical runtime checks.
